entries: Is it some kind of stitch? If so, I would like to learn it.
那是某种针法吗？如果是，我想学。
We will all visit it one day. When someone will not be returning from their visit I like to make them some extra nice clothes; ones that will last.
我们终有一天都会去那里。当有人一去不回时，我喜欢为他们做几件格外体面的衣服，耐穿的那种。

I remember a particularly nice robe I once made. A friend of the deceased whispered something strange over it before taking it to the funeral. I am a bit superstitious, and would very much like to know what he said.

Oh, that's right. He had me stitch it into the hem. I cannot recall what it said though.

我记得曾做过一件特别漂亮的袍子。逝者的一位朋友在把它送去葬礼前，对着它低声念了些什么。我有点迷信，非常想知道他念的是什么。

哦，对了。他让我把话缝进了衣摆里。可我记不得那句是什么了。
This is the town I have known my whole life. Except for when I was a child. I was born in another place. Yes, Emerisk is the only town in the world. And a fine one at that.
这个镇子我认识了一辈子。除了我小的时候，我出生在别的地方。对，埃梅里斯克是世上唯一的镇子。而且是个好镇子。
I had heard there are many entrances; even under the Baron's house!
我听说有许多入口；连男爵宅邸底下都有！
The only dark lord I know of is that baron. He truly has a heart of stone.
我知道的唯一的黑暗领主，就是那个男爵。他的心真是石头做的。
Ah, hello. Forgive my shyness. We don't see too many of your type around here. Would you like some yarn?
啊，你好。请原谅我的羞怯。你这类模样的，我们这儿见得不多。要来点毛线吗？
I sell clothing styles for everyone, and I can make custom pieces as well. You look as though you have not had a new set of clothes in a while.
我卖适合所有人的款式，也能定做。你看上去有些年头没添新衣了。
Is that clothing silk? Oh, sorry. It's just covered in silk. Haha... how... odd...
你穿的是丝绸吗？哦，抱歉。只是上面沾满了丝。哈哈……真……古怪……
I believe I once read of such creatures. The library used to have a collection of books on strange creatures. Any book you could imagine was there.
我相信我从前读到过这样的生物。图书馆曾有一批关于奇异生物的书。你能想象到的任何一本书，那里都有。
Ah yes, now I recall. They are said to be a gentle, but powerful race. It reminds me of the woodsman on the east side of the town. I would very much like to meet him.
啊，对，我想起来了。据说他们是一个温和却强大的种族。这让我想起镇子东边的那位樵夫。我很想见见他。
I have no clothes in your size. Perhaps doll clothes?
没有你这个尺码的衣服。要不……玩偶的衣裳？

I never did find much written about these things. Alas, I wish I knew how to read. Oh, that books were more than pieces of useless wood, sliced thinly and stacked, bound with tree resin and clothed in animal skins.
关于这些东西，我始终没找到什么记载。唉，真希望我识字。哦，要是书不只是把没用的木头削薄、叠起来，用树胶粘好、再裹上兽皮就好了。

They are nothing like the Agmarians. Goblins are cruel, and ugly. Though, can they be blamed for how they look? And, I wonder, are they all really so cruel?

Regardless, I would not venture near them without great caution.

他们和阿格玛人，完全不同。哥布林残忍又丑陋。不过，长相能怪他们吗？再说，我怀疑，他们真的都那么残忍吗？

无论如何，没有万分的谨慎，我绝不会靠近他们。
I say... has there ever been a more curious looking fellow than yourself? How would I even tailor an outfit for you?
我说……还有比你更古怪好奇的家伙吗？我甚至不知道该怎么给你裁衣服。
Greetings, milady. May I interest you in a bolt of fine cloth?
致意，女士。来一匹上好的布料如何？
Oh how I love reading. .. What a strange thing to say, considering I cannot read. Forgive me...
哦，我多么爱读书。……想想这话有多怪，我根本不识字。请原谅……
Are you a bard? I would love to hear your tales from abroad.
你是吟游诗人吗？我很想听你讲讲异乡的故事。
Sometimes people emerge from it with new clothing fashions that I have never before seen. How unusual.
有时人们从迷雾里出来，穿着我从未见过的新款式。真稀奇。

I serve as a tailor. There used to be others but they wandered off into the fog somewhere. Now I must make all the clothes. I specialize in fabric from all over the... the town. Where else would it come from?
我是一名裁缝。从前还有别人，可他们不知走失到迷雾，中的什么地方去了。如今所有衣服都得我做。我专营来自……全镇的织物。还能是哪儿来的呢？
Nice to meet you, friend. May I interest you in some clothing? The flax is grown here in Emerisk. Not that there is anywhere else it might grow.
幸会，朋友。来身衣裳如何？亚麻就种在埃梅里斯克本地。倒也不是说别处能种似的。
I read of it in a book once. That is, I wish I had, for I cannot read. Alas.
我曾在书里读到过它。我是说，但愿我读到过，因为我不识字。唉。
What nice robes you have sir. Have you considered any additional items to spruce up your look? Perhaps a cloak, or a stole?
您的长袍真不错，先生。考虑过再加点什么，让气度更上一层吗？斗篷？还是披肩？

She had such a wonderful collection of books... I remember the day of her funeral. Normally there is a big to-do, and I make fancy clothes. But she requested nothing of the sort beforehand, which was only a week in advance... as if she knew she would pass.
她藏书可丰富了……我还记得她下葬那天。通常葬礼都会大操大办，由我做几身讲究的殓衣。可她在前一周就交代说一概不用，仿佛她早知道自己将去。
I do recall her asking for a book to be buried with her though. Her daughter performed the burial alone.
不过我确实记得，她要求随葬一本书。葬礼是她女儿独自操办的。
Hello, sweet pup. Would you like me to knit you a sweater?
你好，小乖乖。要不要我给你织件毛衣？

I do not care for that gentleman at all. His coin I will accept, for he frequently orders new clothing.

His home is haunted, you know. I once heard strange noises coming from under the floor while visiting.

我一点也不喜欢那位先生。但他的钱我照收，因为他常来订新衣。

告诉你，他的宅子闹鬼。有一次我去做客，听见地板底下传来奇怪的声响。

Everything is like fabric, in a way. Things wear down, and holes appear. Even things like reality. I once saw a hole in the rock, but it did not lead into the hills. It led somewhere entirely different, and something watched me from inside.
从某种角度看，万物都像织物。东西会磨损，破洞会出现。连「现实」这类东西也一样。我曾见过岩石上的一个洞，可它不通向山丘。它通向全然不同的地方，还有东西从里面注视着我。
Very sorry, I did not mean to disturb you with my strange memories. There is no way that what I remember is real. My mind is a mess these days. Everyone's mind is. Have you noticed?
非常抱歉，我不是有意用这些奇怪的记忆吓到你。我记得的东西绝不可能是真的。这些日子我的脑子一团乱。每个人的脑子都是。你注意到了吗？
